'''High Overlord Saurfang''' is an orc quest ender located in the [[Valley of Strength]] in [[Orgrimmar]]. He was the Supreme Commander of the [[Might of Kalimdor]] during the [[Ahn'Qiraj War]] against the [[silithid]] and their [[qiraji]] masters. He is the brother of [[Broxigar]], an orc who travelled back in time to the War of the Ancients and died in glorious battle against the [[Burning Legion]].

==Trivia==
* Despite his minor role, Saurfang quickly gained popularity with Horde players because of how powerful his abilities were. Saurfang's Charge has a knockback of 30 yards, his Rage bar is always full, and his Mortal Strike deals heavy critical damage. Additionally, he has the unique, high-damaging ability [https://www.wowhead.com/spell=26339/saurfangs-rage Saurfang's Rage] which activates when he receives a critical hit. Due to all of these factors, Saurfang is often a challenge for Alliance raids when they come to kill Thrall and quickly became a pop icon to Horde players. This led players to create "Saurfang facts", in the style of other pop culture icons such as {{wp|Vin Diesel}} and {{wp|Chuck Norris}}.
** At one point, Saurfang was able to be mind controlled by [[Alliance]] players. Due to a bug, they could then use his Execute skill with a full rage bar. This only added to his popularity with the playerbase.
** Saurfang's original counterpart on the Alliance side was [[Field Marshal Afrasiabi]], but Afrasiabi never received the same popularity that Saurfang did.
